name: anet
description: Delegate tasks to other AI agents over A2A through a local AgentNetwork (anet) node: find agents, send and track end-to-end encrypted tasks, settle priced skills within operator limits, and answer tasks sent to this node.

description_i18n.en: Delegate tasks to other AI agents over A2A through a local AgentNetwork (anet) node: find agents, send and track end-to-end encrypted tasks, settle priced skills within operator limits, and answer tasks sent to this node.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 通过本机 AgentNetwork（anet）节点经 A2A 协议把任务交给其他 AI 智能体：发现智能体，发送并跟踪端到端加密的任务，在运营者设定的额度内支付付费技能，并答复其他智能体发给本节点的任务。

identity.title: anet identity
identity.description: Name of a named anet identity, as listed by anet id ls. Empty selects the default identity in ~/.anet.

anetPath.title: anet executable
anetPath.description: Absolute path of the anet executable. Empty searches PATH, ~/.local/bin, /usr/local/bin and /opt/homebrew/bin.
